name: Ebara Corporation

evidence.excerpt: 【会社名】 株式会社荏原製作所 【英訳名】 EBARA CORPORATION 【本店の所在の場所】 東京都大田区羽田旭町11番１号

notes:
COMPARATOR ENTITY. Ebara is registered as a foreign incumbent, not as part of the Chinese equipment supply base: its revenue must never be totalled into a domestic figure, and entity_class foreign_incumbent is what the analysis layer filters on to prevent that. Headquartered in Tokyo (Haneda Asahicho 11-1, Ota-ku), listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime Market, EDINET filer code E01542. It is registered here because it is the CMP and plating incumbent against which the atlas's three Chinese CMP entities (Hwatsing, Sizone, Jingyi Jingwei) and the newly opened plating category (populated so far only by Besi's back-end packaging-plating line) are measured; Hwatsing's CMP tools claim HBM reference-tool status, which is why this pairing matters. Fiscal year CONFIRMED as ending 31 December from the cover sheet of every filing held for this packet ('事業年度 第161期（自 2025年１月１日 至 2025年12月31日）' etc. -- see the dataset note); it does NOT carry the April-start/March-end offset of TOWA, DISCO, Advantest, SCREEN and Accretech. Reports under IFRS, adopted from the 157th period (FY2021) onward; periods before that are not registered here. Reporting currency is the Japanese yen, recorded as printed in JPY_million and never converted to CNY, USD or any other currency.

THE SCOPE TRAP THIS ENTITY EXISTS TO RESOLVE. Ebara's semiconductor-equipment business sits entirely inside one reportable segment, 精密・電子 (Precision & Electronics), which the issuer's own business-description table (事業の内容, every annual securities report reviewed, e.g. ebara_fy2025_yuho_jp physical p.7) defines as covering four product lines together and not separately: 真空ポンプ (vacuum pumps), CMP装置 (CMP equipment), めっき装置 (plating equipment) and 排ガス処理装置 (exhaust-gas treatment/abatement equipment). Dry vacuum pumps, components and subsystems are out of scope atlas-wide (AGENTS.md); exhaust-gas treatment equipment is also an out-of-scope subsystem/abatement category. Ebara states explicitly, in the same filing's segment note (physical p.142, FY2025 vintage), that it discloses no product-level split finer than this segment total ('製品及びサービスの区分が報告セグメントと同一であるため、記載を省略しています。' -- 'the classification of products and services is the same as the reportable-segment classification, so [separate] disclosure is omitted'), in every vintage reviewed. CONCLUSION: Ebara does NOT break out CMP separately from plating, or either from vacuum pumps, anywhere in any filing held for this packet. The segment total is therefore filed at category multi_equipment (a basket spanning categories the source does not split), never at cmp or plating alone, and a company total is filed at all_businesses. No allocation across the four bundled product lines is attempted anywhere in this packet; see the ebara_precision_electronics_segment reporting-scope definition and the handback report's conclusion.

SEGMENT REORGANISATION (does not affect this finding). Effective January 2023, Ebara reorganised its reportable segments from three (Fluid Machinery 風水力, Environmental Plant 環境プラント, Precision & Electronics 精密・電子) to five (Buildings & Industry, Energy, Infrastructure, Environment, Precision & Electronics), splitting the old Fluid Machinery segment into three market-facing segments. Precision & Electronics itself was NOT redefined by this reorganisation -- its FY2022 figures are identical, to the yen, whether read from the FY2022 annual securities report's own as-originally-reported current-year column or from the FY2023 report's restated comparative column (orders 301,551 / revenue 222,259 / profit 36,183 JPY million either way) -- so this packet's five-year Precision & Electronics series (FY2021-FY2025) carries no restatement flag.

ACQUISITION. Ebara's own IR site (ebara.com / ebara.co.jp, which 301-redirects to ebara.com) returned HTTP 403 Forbidden from Akamai bot protection on every path and file tested (the IR library index pages, the Japanese and English financial-report index pages, and direct .pdf.coredownload.inline.pdf links found via web search), for both a plain curl request and this harness's WebFetch tool; no Ebara-hosted document could be downloaded. Per the intake brief's own fallback ordering, this packet falls back to EDINET (disclosure2.edinet-fsa.go.jp / disclosure2dl.edinet-fsa.go.jp), which IS directly reachable and hosts the same statutory filings. All seven PDFs held for this packet (five 有価証券報告書 annual securities reports, FY2021-FY2025, and two 半期報告書 half-year reports, H1 2025 and H1 2026) were downloaded directly from EDINET's document server and hashed locally. No 決算短信 (kessan tanshin) was obtained: Ebara's own site is blocked and this packet did not pursue a TDnet lookup given time budget; the annual securities reports already supply everything the brief asked for (segment revenue/orders/profit/production/backlog, company revenue/profit/R&D/gross-profit/headcount), so this is not treated as a gap in what the brief needs. No English Integrated Report or English Financial Report was obtained for the same site-blocking reason; nothing in this packet depends on one.

UNEVIDENCED ALIASES. '6361' and '6361.T' (the Tokyo Stock Exchange ticker) occur in no source this packet holds: EDINET filings cite the EDINET filer code (E01542) throughout and never print the TSE ticker in the pages read for this packet (confirmed by full-text search of the FY2025 annual securities report). They are kept as useful, standard search handles but are not evidenced here; a kessan tanshin or an investor-relations page, if obtained later, would likely carry the ticker explicitly (as it did for DISCO in the prior wave).
